name: Queensland Bond Loan
summary: Interest-free help with a rental bond for low-income Queenslanders, with income limits that count Youth Allowance.
who: Australian citizen, permanent resident, or temporary protection or bridging visa holder
Less than $5,500 in cash or savings among all applicants
Combined gross income within the limits (for example $1,428 a week for one adult)
Rent no more than 60% of the total gross weekly income of all applicants
how: Use the eligibility checker, or contact Housing Services on 13 QGOV (13 74 68)
catches: Youth Allowance counts as income; the Tertiary Access Payment does not.

source.label: Queensland Government: Bond loan and rental grant eligibility

evidence.quote: less than $5,500 in cash or savings among all the bond loan applicants
60% of the total gross weekly income of all applicants
